x: Basil Walden won the Club 75 yards handicap with John Smith 2nd and Eddie Lacey 3rd, while Stan Davies showed some of his old form when he won the 2 miles run off 280 yards in 9 min. 21 secs.
In the Junior match we again triumphed, with 29 pts., with Shaftesbury H., 22 ; and Ealing and Maidenhead, 8 each. John Smith scored a double win in the 100 and 220, with J.

There was also an open Schools 4 x 110 yds. relay, which was won by the Drayton Manor School in 48.2 secs. In the Junior match we had John Smith 1st in the 100, with Ian Forrester winning the 220 yds., Frank Wright won the 440, with J.

As we have several members with Middlesex qualifications, we were glad to see that John Smith secured 3rd place in the County 220 yds. Junior race, while in the Senior events we had the following successes :—
Also on the programme was an Inter-Club Junior match, and we fared better in this and came out on top of the six competing clubs. John Smith was 3rd in both the 100 and 220 yds., with J.

Lewis was anchoring for Santa Monica in their world record breaking run of 1:18.68 but John, running for John Smith's All-Star team which included Drummond, Jarrett and Mitchell, closed dramatically on that last stage and brought his team home also inside the old figures.
